steps: Blend roasted pistachios into a smooth, rich paste
Fold in sugar and a touch of cream for spreadability
Shred the kataifi pastry into fine strands
Toast gently in a pan until golden and crisp
Melt chocolate and temper it for a glossy finish
Line moulds with chocolate, add filling layers, and seal

swaps.why: Shop has stovetop but no tempering machine; manual method works for small batches
